summary: Operator: RV sites $40 weekdays / $50 weekends / $62.50 holidays all year; 18 back-in 50A sites (5 full hookup), up to 60 ft; booked on Let's Camp. Riverview confirmed (RV pads ~25-40 m from a ~60 m wide Sac River across a mowed, tree-dotted bank) - riverfront upgrade lead. Google 4.9/133.

WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade): stored riverview confirmed at least. Imagery (leaf-off, 0.4 m/px): the 13 'Riverfront' back-ins (sites 3-15) angle off the NE drive with their ends ~25-40 m from the Sac River, a channel ~60 m wide (riverfront class); between pad and water is the campground's own mowed bank dotted with trees, no road or day-use strip. The operator's RV-park photos show picnic tables and fire rings on that grass with open water plainly visible between scattered trunks. The operator names the sites 'Riverfront Full Hook-Up' / 'Riverfront Water/Electric'. Under the open-apron rule this reads as riverfront for sites 3-15; not changed, per the brief (operator water claim above the stored value = re-audit lead). The meadow sites 1-2 and creek-front XL sites 16/18/20 are set back.
